tool: tts measure --compare 1 (examples/tts.rs), one process per voice and text file, release build
texts: benchmark/tts/paragraphs-en.txt and paragraphs-fr.txt (5 and 10 sentences, written for this project) and sentences-en.txt / sentences-fr.txt (short sentences and one 3-sentence paragraph)
modes: per-sentence (one library call per sentence, silences added, what the app does) and whole-text (one library call, the behaviour before sentence timings), interleaved inside each repetition
pauses: 250 ms after a sentence, 600 ms after a paragraph, divided by the speed factor
note: no speechlab.exe window was open (the owner closed theirs; the app started for the UI test was stopped before). Generated WAV files were deleted after each repetition; only timings are kept. The first (cold) run of each voice is excluded from the medians.
